## Pipeline shape

Source -> intermediate ops (`map`, `filter`, `sorted`) -> terminal op (`collect`, `reduce`, `forEach`). Intermediate ops are **lazy**; nothing runs until the terminal op.

## Collectors

`Collectors.toList`, `groupingBy`, `partitioningBy`, `joining` cover most needs. Java 16+ adds `Stream.toList()`.

## Pitfalls

Don't mutate shared state inside a stream. Avoid streams for trivial loops — clarity first. Parallel streams help only for large CPU-bound work.
